meta.title: Phoebe voice announcements
meta.description: Plays Chinese announcements for DSH questions and final replies on the host, using Phoebe’s voice by default. Open the component row to set the Fish Audio key, voice ID, and playback mode. Off by default; requires ffplay. Bundled Phoebe reminders play offline; excerpt mode sends short excerpts to Fish Audio. Switch modes below the chat composer.
